changes.title: Stump polish
items: You can cast the soundsystem spell anywhere on a stump's cut top, not just its middle; the 🎶 and its hold prompt show when you're on it
Stumps grow more irregular: wobblier cuts, notches, off-centre hearts and uneven rings
Far-off stump wisps are small soft glows that fade with distance, not big squares
The spell's rainbow analyser is an even circle round the stump, no longer longer at the bottom

changes.title: Input presses
items: T toggles auto-talk again, and remapped mouse buttons can toggle talking.
Hat presses count once on fast and slow displays.
Right and middle mouse bindings keep working while held, including invitations and using objects.

changes.title: Trunk band
items: Pine trunks no longer have a pale orange band where they go up into the leaves

changes.title: Quick win pulse
items: After a quick win the victory lap's pulse runs the whole ley line home, round the dancefloor's ring to the treehouse, rather than stopping at the top of the ring
The ley line's dots no longer show through the ground past the horizon's bend or behind a hill
